title: Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1994
ACT VIII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the
Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 8th September, 1994]
No. PAB/LEGIS.V(10)/94, dated 8-9-1994.---The
Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 6th July, 1994 and assented
to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of Act V of 1958

ACT VIII OF 1994
ACT VIII OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
An Act further to amend the
Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 8th September, 1994]
No. PAB/LEGIS.V(10)/94, dated 8-9-1994.---The
Balochistan Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 6th July, 1994 and assented
to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Assembly.
2. Amendment of section 4 of Act V of 1958.---In the Balochistan
Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958, after clause (g) of section 4, the following
new clause shall be inserted, namely--
"(h) one
residential house owned and self-occupied for his residential purpose by a
retired Provincial Government servant and ex-servicemen."
